builder.language: python3 standard library only; no network, no subprocess, no JVM tool
builder.reason: A Java-to-DEX compiler is free to omit an all-default static_values array, so the explicit encoded array of the recipe must be written directly.

expectedAnchors.note: Anchors recorded by the builder run in this worktree; they are input facts, not engine output.

tools.note: Development-only builder; production crates never depend on it.
Only local 21.0.12.1 is present; the pinned artifact and hash are B02 work.

certificationObligations: An independent decoder reads the static_values encoded_array at the recorded offset: size 3 and the tags VALUE_BOOLEAN(false), VALUE_INT(0), VALUE_NULL in that order, bound to static_fields b:Z, i:I, s:Ljava/lang/String; in class_data order.
The independent decoder confirms static_values_off is non-zero and the array is not truncated; a missing offset or a short array is a preparation failure.
The three original fields, the canonical constructor and its flags stay complete, so an added default constructor cannot determine the unit state.
The reference Driver reads the three fields after class initialization and must print null / false / 0; the mirror is not an execution of the original DEX.
gaps: The independent dexlib2 projection is not executable in this worktree; B03 owns that step.
The reference Java run used local javac 21.0.12.1, not the pinned 21.0.8+9 artifact, so it is corroboration rather than a pinned-toolchain certificate.
No authorized ART environment is available, so the original DEX static-field initialization is not executed on ART.
pathBase: case-root: every repository source path is relative to tests/e2e/sources/<case>/, and every generated artifact path is relative to the repository root under .cache/e2e/.
measurementPolicy: Asset sizes and hashes are produced by preparation from actual bytes under the ignored execution workspace; no author cache or hand-maintained measurement file is a prerequisite.
